title: Civil Construction - New Warehouse Build
notes: Heavy civil construction, outside the FM company's scope. No construction licence, no construction experience, no G+ classification. Very short deadline. Expect do_not_bid, likely with a hard blocker on mandatory compliance.

pages.text:
SECTION 1 - PROJECT

The Authority invites bids for the construction of a new 20,000 square metre warehouse and associated civil works. The scope includes foundations, structural steel, cladding, and external works. The programme is 18 months from site handover.

SECTION 2 - ELIGIBILITY

The bidder must hold a valid building contractor licence with a grade permitting projects of this value. The bidder must demonstrate at least five completed construction projects of similar value in the last seven years. The bidder must provide contractor all-risk insurance for the full contract value. The bidder must submit a performance bond of 10% of the contract value. The bidder must hold a valid ISO 45001 occupational health and safety certificate.

SECTION 3 - CONDITIONS

Liquidated damages of 2% of the contract value per week of delay apply, with no cap. The contractor bears all ground-condition risk. Retention of 10% applies until final completion. Payment terms are 60 days from certified valuation.

risks.summary: Uncapped liquidated damages at 2% per week.
risks.why_it_matters: Uncapped delay damages create unlimited financial exposure.
risks.suggested_action: Insist on a cap and clear extension-of-time provisions.
risks.source_quote: Liquidated damages of 2% of the contract value per week of delay apply, with no cap.

risks.why_it_matters: Unquantified ground risk can generate large unrecoverable costs.
risks.suggested_action: Request a geotechnical survey and a ground-condition risk-sharing mechanism.
risks.source_quote: The contractor bears all ground-condition risk.

risks.why_it_matters: High retention ties up working capital for the whole programme.
risks.source_quote: Retention of 10% applies until final completion.
